periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis is oriented nearly vertically, with a slight lateral tilt at the superior pole relative to the midline of the cranium.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a significantly higher vertical-to-horizontal ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: The patch displays a pronounced downward tapering effect, with the visual mass concentrating towards the inferior margin.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are widely set at the lateral-superior boundaries of the cranium, with a gap approximately equal to the horizontal width of the head at the eye level.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the ears exhibit a smooth, high-curvature semicircular profile.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-yellow chromophore staining present across the abdominal pelage; oral cavity is open, exposing the tongue and lower dentition.
